title: Investing Stats
summary: Search and explore SEC insider transactions.
lead: I built a searchable history of SEC insider transactions, with company filters, filing details, and CSV exports.
description: How Jackson Pipe built Investing Stats: SEC filing ingestion, SQLite persistence, failure handling, and a searchable transaction history.
ogDescription: Making public filings searchable, and keeping stored history useful when a refresh fails.

title: Brawl Stats
lead: I built a Brawl Stars analytics app that compares characters and recommends teams for a selected map.
description: Inside Brawl Stats: Jackson Pipe’s work on battle-data collection, sample-aware rankings, team recommendations, and cache invalidation.
ogDescription: Separating character strength, team interactions, and the amount of evidence behind a recommendation.

title: StarCraft II agents
summary: Scripted bots, learned policies, and replay training.
lead: Three projects exploring StarCraft II bots: scripted strategy, learned action policies, and training from replays.
description: Jackson Pipe’s StarCraft II engineering notes: SpecTactics, μSC2/MuBot, and Augur; stale game state, action selection, and replay-training experiments.
ogDescription: Three approaches to playing under uncertainty, and the difficulty of knowing whether a change helps.
